name: Lucas Maddox
education: University of Wisconsin-Madison, BS Electrical Engineering (graduated ~May 2023)
prior_work: Hardware Test Engineer II at SpaceX/Starlink for ~3 years (2023-2025), owned test systems for Starlink battery/solar array and hardware yield/failure analysis for satellite production. Cofounded University of Wisconsin's solar car team (Badger Solar Racing) in 2021, served as Founding Electrical Director then Chief Electrical Engineer; built the electrical system from scratch and led the team to Rookie of the Year at the 2023 Formula Sun Grand Prix (230 miles completed, 7th of 9 teams).
milestone_by_26: Cofounded and built UW-Madison's solar car team (Badger Solar Racing) from scratch, winning Rookie of the Year at the 2023 Formula Sun Grand Prix. Spent ~3 years at SpaceX/Starlink owning critical test and manufacturing systems for satellite production. Founded Kyten Technologies (YC W26) at age 24. However, no evidence of significant funding, viral product, major award, or notable research beyond the YC acceptance itself.
company_outcome: Raised $500k (Jan 2026, YC W26). Building a factory to manufacture custom aerospace-grade battery packs for defense/aerospace OEMs. Early stage.
background_notes: Based in Seattle/Redmond, WA. Ultramarathon runner. Focused on SpaceX since high school graduation. No clear evidence of privileged family background or elite university pedigree — attended University of Wisconsin-Madison (strong public engineering school, not Ivy/Stanford).
